interval_metadata.source_semantics: v2 precipitation and radiation are deaccumulated; source values preserved without differencing, summing or unit conversion
interval_metadata.interval_start_basis: inferred from advertised 1H cadence and last-forecast-interval descriptions; +0 has no preceding forecast interval
interval_metadata.unresolved: exact radiation averaging bounds and within-interval distribution are not supplied; snowfall is mass, not snow depth
